newsitem.title: POLAND: POLL - Polish WIG index seen at 14,919 end-August.
newsitem.headline: POLL - Polish WIG index seen at 14,919 end-August.

text.p: The main all-share WIG index of the Warsaw bourse is seen at 14,919.1 points at the end of this month, a monthly Reuter poll of leading securities houses showed.

The average prediction for the blue-chip WIG20 index was 1,486.1 points. The average forecast for the main WIG index at the end of October was 15,466.9 points and analysts saw it at 18,681.3 on August 31, 1998.
On August 1, the WIG closed at 15,116.8 points and the WIG20 at 1.476.2.

WIG 1997 high 18,339.4 (Feb 18), low 14,421.6 (Jan 6) WIG20 1997 high 1894.9 (Feb 18), low 1448.6 (Jan 2) FORECASTS CONTRIBUTED BY: BDM PKO BP, DM PBG SA-Pekao SA Group, DM Bank Slaski SA, DM PBK SA, BM PBR SA, Creditanstalt Securities SA, Bank Zachodni SA, DM Penetrator, ING BSK Asset Management, COK Bank Handlowy SA, CBM WBK SA, CBM Pekao SA, Raiffeisen Capital & Investment Polska, BRE Brokers, BM BGZ, BM PBKS-Pekao SA Group. The forecasts were submitted on July 31.
